pages.text: $(bold)Network Cables$() carry a signal inside an insulated line that $(italic)doesn't$() leak into neighbours — sixteen dyed colours, so sixteen independent channels can run side by side without crosstalk.
pages.title: Coloured Channels

pages.text: Match colours to keep circuits apart: red for the door, blue for the lights, green for the farm — all in the same wall, never touching.
pages.title: Keeping Them Apart
